heading.en: The 1945 elections and his overthrow in 1948

body.zh-Hant: 據學者 Juan Manuel Pérez 的研究，1945年舉行的選舉中，候選人阿圖羅·羅梅羅博士被禁止參選，軍人候選人卡斯塔涅達·卡斯特羅將軍贏得這場舞弊選舉。他對國家維持強力的政治控制，並對軍隊進行改革；1948年12月14日，軍官們推翻了他。
body.en: According to Juan Manuel Pérez, in the elections held in 1945 Dr. Arturo Romero was barred from running and the military candidate, General Castañeda Castro, won the fraudulent contest. He kept strong political control over the country and introduced reforms in the army; officers overthrew him on 14 December 1948.

citations.quote: Cuando las elecciones se celebraron al año siguiente, 1945
al Dr. Arturo Romero se le prohibió participar
el general Castaneda Castro, ganó esas elecciones fraudulentas
Castaneda mantuvo un fuerte control político sobre el país
Castaneda Castro introdujo reformas en el Ejército
Estos oficiales derrocaron a Castaneda Castro el 14 de diciembre de 1948
Castaneda Castro, también militar, que estaba gobernando el país desde 1945

heading.zh-Hant: 清末諮議局議長與湖南都督
heading.en: Hunan assembly speaker and military governor

body.zh-Hant: 譚延闓是湖南茶陵人。宣統元年（1909）他出任湖南省諮議局議長，並發起組織憲友會；1911年辛亥革命爆發後，他在變亂的湖南政局中出任湖南都督。
body.en: Tan Yankai was a native of Chaling, Hunan. In 1909 (Xuantong 1) he became speaker of the Hunan provincial assembly and helped found the Constitutional Friends Society; after the 1911 Revolution broke out he became military governor of Hunan amid the turmoil there.

citations.quote: 湖南茶陵人
(1909) 出任湖南省諮議局議長,發起組織憲友會
1911 年辛亥革命爆發後,在變亂的湖南政局中,譚延闓出任湖南都督

heading.en: 1923: ministries under Sun Yat-sen and return to Hunan

body.zh-Hant: 1923年3月2日，孫中山在廣州組建海陸軍大元帥大本營，譚延闓被任命為內政部長；任職不及兩月，5月改任建設部長。同年7月16日，孫中山任命他為湖南省長兼湘軍總司令，8月7日他抵達衡陽，就任湖南省長兼北伐討賊軍總司令。
body.en: On 2 March 1923 Sun Yat-sen set up the Grand Marshal's headquarters in Guangzhou and Tan was appointed interior minister; he held it for under two months and in May became minister of construction. On 16 July Sun named him governor of Hunan and commander-in-chief of the Hunan Army, and on 7 August he reached Hengyang and took up that post.

citations.quote: 1923 年 3 月 2 日,孫中山在廣州組建海陸軍大元帥大本營
自任大元帥,統率各軍,並委任譚

heading.zh-Hant: 1924–1926年：國民黨中央職務與北伐聯軍
heading.en: 1924–26: Kuomintang central posts and the Northern Expedition coalition

body.zh-Hant: 1924年1月，譚延闓在國民黨一大上當選中央執行委員；9月任建國湘軍總司令；11月孫中山北上後，他出任北伐聯軍總司令主持北伐事務，不久兵敗贛南，北伐未果。1926年1月，他在國民黨二大上當選中央常務委員，旋代理政治委員會主席。
body.en: In January 1924 Tan was elected to the Central Executive Committee at the Kuomintang's First Congress; in September he became commander-in-chief of the Jianguo Hunan Army, and after Sun went north in November he commanded the Northern Expedition coalition forces, which was defeated in southern Jiangxi. In January 1926 he was elected to the Central Standing Committee at the Second Congress and soon acted as chairman of the Political Council.

9 月任建國湘軍總司令

heading.en: 1928–30: Chairman of the National Government and head of the Executive Yuan

body.zh-Hant: 1928年2月，譚延闓出任南京國民政府主席，10月轉任行政院長，1930年9月病逝於南京。
body.en: In February 1928 Tan became chairman of the Nanjing National Government, in October he moved to head the Executive Yuan, and he died in Nanjing in September 1930.

people.name: Teodoro Picado Michalski
people.nameZh: 特奧多羅·皮卡多·米哈爾斯基

body.zh-Hant: 據學者 Fabrice E. Lehoucq 的研究，皮卡多1944年的總統選舉勝利普遍被視為卡爾德龍·瓜迪亞支持的結果。皮卡多在1945年初支持一項選舉法案，旨在消除各政治勢力製造舞弊選票的可能。1948年選舉結果顯示反對派候選人烏拉特擊敗卡爾德龍·瓜迪亞，但結果受到許多卡爾德龍派質疑，他們在1948年3月1日召開的國會會議上使烏拉特的勝利被宣告無效；其後由菲格雷斯統率的軍隊贏得內戰。
body.en: According to Fabrice E. Lehoucq, Picado's presidential victory in 1944 was widely seen as the product of Calderón Guardia's support. In early 1945 Picado backed an electoral bill meant to remove the possibility of fraudulent votes by all political forces. The 1948 results showed the opposition candidate Ulate had defeated Calderón Guardia, but many Calderón supporters contested them and managed to annul Ulate's victory in the congressional session convened for 1 March 1948; the army led by Figueres later won the civil war.

citations.quote: La victoria presidencial de Picado Michalski en 1944 fue vista ampliamente
como producto del apoyo de Calderón Guardia
Picado apoyó un proyecto de ley, a principios de 1945
cuyo fin era eliminar la posibilidad que tenían todas
de fabricar votos fraudulentos
Los resultados de las elecciones de 1948 indicaron que el candidato opositor
Otilio Ulate Blanco, había derrotado a Calderón Guardia
fue cuestionado por muchos calderonistas
quienes lograron anular la victoria de Ulate en la sesión del Congreso
convocada para el primero de marzo de 1948
el ejército conducido por Figueres Ferrer
ganó la guerra civil

gaps.note: 審查（Opus 2026-11-11）：Lehoucq 原文只寫 1941 年 5 月卡爾德龍·瓜迪亞及其議員「支持皮卡多出任國會議長」（apoyaron … para Presidente del Congreso），未明寫其當選或在任，起訖亦缺；原職位改待查證。需國會（Asamblea Legislativa）官方歷任議長名單或其他 A／B 來源。
